description: Declared Architecture Assistant tool surface for the restricted OpenCode runtime. The startup capability probe reads this manifest and fails closed if any tool is not namespaced, is missing codemode:false, or has no explicit allow rule in assistant-runtime/opencode.json.

tools.name: architecture_probe_context
tools.description: Startup-probe-only tool. Returns the OpenCode-supplied execution context as bounded, non-sensitive data. It is not connected to the architecture helper API.
